coverage: Complete English editions: named cast, both messenger roles, guard, named ancestors and identifiable mythic references. Ordinary family and betrothal identities are immediate; no later outcomes in cards.

entities.name: Antigone
entities.body: Oedipus’s daughter, sister of Ismene, Eteocles and Polyneices.

entities.name: Creon
entities.body: King of Thebes, Antigone and Ismene’s uncle, and Haemon’s father.

entities.name: Ismene
entities.body: Antigone’s sister, another daughter of Oedipus.

entities.name: Haemon
entities.body: Creon and Eurydice’s son, betrothed to Antigone.

entities.name: Teiresias
entities.body: The blind prophet of Thebes.

entities.name: Eurydice
entities.body: Creon’s wife and Haemon’s mother.

entities.name: The Theban elders
entities.body: The elders of Thebes who speak and sing as the chorus.

entities.name: The guard
entities.body: The sentry posted to watch Polyneices’ body.

entities.name: The messenger
entities.body: The attendant who reports events outside the palace.

entities.name: The palace messenger
entities.body: The second messenger, reporting from inside Creon’s palace.

entities.name: Eteocles
entities.body: Oedipus’s son and brother of Polyneices, Antigone and Ismene.

entities.name: Polyneices
entities.body: Oedipus’s son and brother of Eteocles, Antigone and Ismene.

entities.name: Oedipus
entities.body: The former king of Thebes and father of Antigone, Ismene, Eteocles and Polyneices.

entities.name: Laius
entities.body: An earlier king of Thebes, Oedipus’s father.

entities.name: Menoeceus
entities.body: Creon’s father.

entities.name: Megareus
entities.body: A son of Creon and Eurydice, and Haemon’s brother.

entities.name: Labdacus
entities.body: Laius’s father, an ancestor of the Theban royal family.

entities.name: Cadmus
entities.body: The legendary founder of Thebes.

entities.name: Amphion
entities.body: The legendary king and musician associated with building Thebes’ walls.

entities.name: Zeus
entities.body: The chief god of the Greek pantheon.

entities.name: Ares
entities.body: The Greek god of war.

entities.name: Bacchus / Dionysus
entities.body: The god of wine and ecstatic worship, closely associated with Thebes.

entities.name: Athena
entities.body: The goddess of wisdom and protector of cities, here called Pallas.

entities.name: Persephone
entities.body: The queen of the underworld, here called Persephassa.

entities.name: Pluto
entities.body: The ruler of the underworld, also known as Hades.

entities.name: Tantalus
entities.body: Niobe’s father in Greek legend.

entities.name: Niobe
entities.body: The legendary daughter of Tantalus, associated with a weeping rock on Mount Sipylus.

entities.name: Danae
entities.body: The mother of Perseus in Greek legend, confined by her father in a bronze chamber.

entities.name: Dryas
entities.body: The father of Lycurgus, the Thracian king who opposed Bacchus.

entities.name: Lycurgus
entities.body: The Thracian king, son of Dryas, who opposed the worship of Bacchus.

entities.name: The Muses
entities.body: The goddesses who inspire poetry, music and the arts.

entities.name: Boreas
entities.body: The god of the north wind, father of Cleopatra in the legend recalled by the chorus.

entities.name: Erechtheus
entities.body: A legendary king of Athens, an ancestor in the family of Boreas’s daughter.

entities.name: Demeter
entities.body: The goddess of agriculture, associated with the rites at Eleusis.

entities.name: Hecate
entities.body: The goddess associated with crossroads and the underworld.

entities.name: The Maenads
entities.body: The ecstatic female followers of Bacchus, also called Bacchanals or Thyiads.

entities.name: Cleopatra
entities.body: The daughter of Boreas and wife of Phineus in the legend recalled by the chorus.

entities.name: The sons of Phineus
entities.body: The two sons of Phineus and Cleopatra in the chorus’s legend.

entities.name: The stepmother in the legend
entities.body: Phineus’s second wife, stepmother of his sons by Cleopatra.

entities.name: Semele
entities.body: The Theban princess who is Dionysus’s mother.
